Did you know the common kingfisher dives underwater using special vision to catch fish? 💙🐟

Also known as the Eurasian kingfisher, this sparrow-sized bird features bright blue upperparts and orange underparts. Found across Eurasia and North Africa, it nests in riverbank burrows.
